text: If you have the words, there's always a chance that you'll find the way.
author: Seamus Heaney

text: It took me quite a long time to develop a voice, and now that I have it, I am not going to be silent.
author: Madeleine K. Albright

text: I'll never forget. I'll never give up. I'll never be quiet. I promise.
author: Angie Thomas

text: When we share those stories we've been scared to share, voicelessness loses its wicked grasp.
author: Jo Ann Fore

text: Your voice is the most potent magic in existence.
author: Michael Bassey Johnson

text: You are closer than you think and more qualified in your message than you could ever fathom.
author: Rebecca Campbell

text: Three things I know to be true: You ARE a writer. The world is waiting for YOUR voice. Nobody can tell your story but YOU.
author: Jeanette LeBlanc

text: Finding your voice is a journey of discovering yourself.
author: Ute Wieczorek-King

author: Rosalie Fishon

text: When I'm hungry, I eat. When I'm thirsty, I drink. When I feel like saying something, I say it.
author: Madonna

text: Give voice to what you know to be true, and do not be afraid of being disliked or exiled.
author: Eve Ensler

text: We who have means and a voice must use them to help those who have neither.
author: Jennifer Donnelly

text: When the whole world is silent, even one voice becomes powerful.
author: Malala Yousafzai

text: When we speak we are afraid our words will not be heard or welcomed. But when we are silent, we are still afraid. So it is better to speak.
author: Audre Lorde

text: The most courageous act is still to think for yourself. Aloud.
author: Coco Chanel

text: Speak up and speak clearly. I want to hear what you have to say because it matters.
author: Felicia Johnson

text: Even when they refuse to listen, I'll keep talking anyway.
author: Nadege Richards

text: Our lives begin to end the day we become silent about the things that matter.
author: Martin Luther King Jr.

text: It only takes one voice, at the right pitch, to start an avalanche.
author: Dianna Hardy

text: Each of you has a distinctive voice. When you find it, your story will be told. You will be heard.
author: John Grisham

text: Stand before the people you fear and speak your mind — even if your voice shakes.

text: The one thing that you have that nobody else has is you. Your voice, your mind, your story, your vision.
author: Neil Gaiman

text: God put something in my heart to get across, and that's what I'm going to focus on — using my voice as an instrument and doing what needs to be done.

text: If I have a platform and a voice, I should use it for my people.
author: Bad Bunny

text: The human voice is the first and most natural musical instrument, also the most emotional.
author: Klaus Schulze

text: If you hear a voice within you say 'you cannot paint,' then by all means paint, and that voice will be silenced.
author: Vincent Van Gogh

text: Real guts are nothing more than developing your inner voice to the point where it is louder and stronger than the voice of your fear.
author: Georgette Mosbacher

text: Listen to the inner voice that allows you to be you.
author: Elvis Stojko

text: Have the courage to follow your heart and intuition. They somehow already know what you truly want to become. Everything else is secondary.
author: Steve Jobs

text: Somewhere inside, we hear a voice. It leads us in the direction of the person we wish to become. But it is up to us whether or not to follow.

text: There is always one true inner voice. Trust it.
author: Gloria Steinem

text: Don't let the voices of other people's opinions drown out your own.
